text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the day of the decisive battle has 
arrived! Umamusume, boil over like 
scalding water!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
At the specially prepared venue in Yukoma 
Onsen, the "Japaaan Cup Dirt" is finally 
about to begin.

A revenge match against Espoir City. The 
mock race was dubbed the 'Japaaahn Cup 
Dirt.'

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first favorite is Transcend! The 
second favorite is Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm in tip-top shape right now. 
I'll be the wall you two have to 
overcome~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, don't you dare let your guard down. 
I'm totally gonna make 'em yelp!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And chasing the top two—Wonder Acute! 
She's slightly behind in the odds, but 
she's bursting with fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuhoooo~, I'm gonna do it! I'll definitely 
do it! There's no way I'm losing this 
time!

With the pride of dirt Umamusume on the 
line, the curtain has finally risen on 
this fierce battle! However—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hyaa~...!? Well would ya look at that...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Wonder Acute! She stumbled at the 
start! Could she have been wound up a bit 
too tight?

Unlike turf races, the fundamental tactic 
in dirt races is to take a forward 
position and push all the way through.

And on top of that, your opponents are 
Transcend and Espoir City. Against such 
titans, this delayed start is far too 
painful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status: 『Yellow Light』. However, there 
is still hope.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Acute! I won the Japan Cup 
miraculously. You can win too!!

Cheered on by the friends who worked 
alongside us for the sake of the Yukoma 
Hot Spring Resort――

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right, there's no way I'm giving 
up. I gotta repay my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The final stretch... from here on out...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Transcend! Victory is all 
but assured! No one can catch her. And 
now—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In second place is Espoir City! It seems 
the race will finish just as the odds 
predicted."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, no helping it. Guess today I'll 
settle for 2nd place... or not?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute from the inside! Wonder Acute 
from the inside! She's surging forward 
with incredible momentum!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fiercely chasing down Espoir City up 
ahead!! The gap is still large—and yet!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally gonna——get my revennnnge!! 
Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line now! First place 
goes to Transcend! And as Espoir City 
holds her ground—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute edges ahead by a nose!! 
Second place goes to Wonder Acuteee!!

A miracle occurred. The race concluded 
with 1st place: Transcend, 2nd place: 
Wonder Acute, and 3rd place: Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Accu-san... Are you okay!? Reaching 
from that position... aren't you overdoing 
it a bit too much!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *wheeze*, *pant*, *pant*... Are 
you serious? No way I lost...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What the hell is going on here!? You gotta 
have some kind of secret, right!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The secret, Espo-san, is hot spring 
mineral crust, y'know. Mineral crust.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Hot spring mineral deposits...? You 
mean the stuff I took one of?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Espo has one. But I've received so 
many from you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Body's all warm, heart's all warm. There's 
no way I'm gonna lose after being looked 
after every single day!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tch, then the reason we lost is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I guess the nose difference was just a 
matter of blooming difference. And on that 
note, thank you and good night.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you both for today. Let's run 
lots of races together again, okay?

And so, in the secret race held at the hot 
spring resort, the "Japaaan Cup Dirt," 
Wonder Acute ran a magnificent race.
